Based on the image, here is the layout description:

**Layout Structure:**
*   **Slide Preview (Left):** The slide thumbnails are located in a vertical sidebar on the **left** side of the screen. It shows "SLIDES — 2" with thumbnails for slides 01 and 02.
*   **Code Editor Pane (Bottom):** The code editor is positioned at the **bottom** of the screen, below the main slide canvas.
*   **Main Canvas (Center/Right):** The large area in the center/right displays the actual slide preview ("Deck title").

**Code Editor Header Bar Details:**
*   **Tabs:** The header contains the following tabs from left to right: **SLIDE**, **BG**, **OVERLAY**, **NOTES**, **ASSETS**, and **THEME**. (The "SLIDE" tab is currently active/highlighted).
*   **Right-side Controls:** On the right end of this header bar, there is the file name (**SLIDES/TITLE.TSX**), followed by a **Format** button (with curly braces icon), a **Save** button (with floppy disk icon), and a **Chevron-down** button.

**Specific Button Inquiry:**
**Yes**, there is a small button with a panel/rectangle icon. It is located immediately to the **left** of the chevron-down button at the far right of the code editor's header bar (between the Save button and the dropdown arrow).
